faq.q: How much does affordable SEO cost in the UK?
faq.a: Most UK small businesses pay £89 to £400 a month for affordable SEO. Managed agency campaigns usually start around £1,000 a month.
They can be, if the deliverables are clear and the work is real: technical fixes, service pages, listings and reporting. Avoid any package that relies on bulk backlinks or guarantees rankings.

faq.q: What is the cheapest way to do SEO for a small business?
faq.a: Do the basics yourself: claim your Google Business Profile and Bing Places, add your services with prices and locations to your website, collect reviews, and verify Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools. It's free, but takes time.

faq.q: Does affordable SEO include ChatGPT and AI search?
faq.a: Not always. Ask whether the plan includes Bing indexing, structured data and AI visibility tracking. The ContentFellow Search Fellow includes all three.

faq.q: How long does affordable SEO take to work?
faq.a: Technical fixes show within weeks; rankings and AI mentions usually take 3 to 6 months to build, depending on competition in your area.

faq.q: Can I cancel an SEO contract?
faq.a: It depends on the provider; many ask for 6 to 12 months. ContentFellow bills monthly and you can cancel from the next month.
